implementation.selection_authority: OptionGoal proposal only; OptionAuthority remains the admission owner
hard_filters_before_ranking: stage phase and derived motion authorization
validated target and accepted semantic zone
explicit feasibility and exact per-option guard set

evidence.guard_facts: Every supplied guard has exactly one non-empty evidence ID; the decision trace preserves those IDs.
evidence.explorer_urgency: KEEP_ESCAPE_ROUTE and BREAK_LOS require an ordinal rank in [0,255] and a non-empty evidence ID; larger ranks preempt lower ranks within the same documented priority class even when nominal utility is lower.
evidence.intercept_vs_base_defense: Only receives the shared imminent-threat priority when one evidence-bearing integer-nanosecond interval satisfies guardian_arrival_upper + buffer < explorer_arrival_lower; equality/overlap/reversal do not qualify.

utility.feature_range: [0,1], finite, no missing or extra role features
utility.profile: immutable explicit role/schema/profile ID; no implicit deployed default weights
utility.bound: sum(abs(weights)) <= 1 and features in [0,1] prove score in [-1,1]
utility.hysteresis: utility-unit delta in [0,2]; switch only for strict improvement above delta after minimum dwell
utility.tie_break: priority, urgency, utility, OptionKind, typed target order, stable key; proposal and evidence ordering normalized

implementation.fallback: exactly one feasible targetless HOLD_SAFE proposal is mandatory; safety/stage/health failures force it before ranking; malformed/missing fallback fails explicitly.
implementation.computation_bound: at most 256 proposals per selection; higher configured caps and oversized inputs are rejected
implementation.selection_trace: SelectionResult includes selected goal, priority, bounded utility contributions/profile, reason, changed flag, and ordered alternative evaluations with rejection reasons and evidence IDs.

limitations: Guard, urgency, feasibility and timing evidence IDs are traceability fields, not authentication; a runtime producer/adapter must validate provenance and derive them from observation-only inputs.
The pure selector does not calculate collision sweeps, visibility, capture geometry, belief calibration, route-time intervals or semantic-zone geometry; it only accepts validated assessor outputs.
The evidence does not claim organizer-approved production utility weights. Deployment requires frozen per-role profiles and calibration/ablation on held-out maps/opponents.
No tactics ROS node, ExecuteOption client orchestration, two-robot simulator/referee loop, DDS/QoS behavior, MVSim, physical test or G4 rehearsal was run.
next_work: P5.4 continuous event/referee and isolated two-role simulation integration; keep all ROS, provenance, runtime and G4 gates open until tested.
